# `apple` operations

10 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### apple.devices

**Apple devices on the Mac**

Read Simulator and connected physical-device inventories using Xcode on a configured SSH Mac.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remote` | string | yes |  | non-empty |

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.devices '{"remote":"<remote>"}'
```

### apple.build

**Build native iOS app**

Synchronize an optional local project, then build the selected Xcode scheme on the Mac.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remote` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `path` | string |  |  | Optional local project to sync before execution |
| `project` | string | yes |  |  |
| `scheme` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `configuration` | string |  | `"debug"` | one of `debug`, `release` |
| `destination` | string | yes |  |  |
| `team_id` | string |  |  |  |
| `allow_provisioning_updates` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `3600` | 30 to 86400 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call apple.build '{"remote":"<remote>","project":"<project>","scheme":"<scheme>","destination":"<destination>"}'
```

### apple.simulator

**Control Apple Simulator**

Boot, shut down, install, launch, terminate, open a URL or capture an actual Apple Simulator on the Mac.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remote` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `device` | string | yes |  |  |
| `action` | string | yes |  | one of `boot`, `shutdown`, `install`, `launch`, `terminate`, `openurl`, `screenshot` |
| `app` | string |  |  |  |
| `bundle_id` | string |  |  |  |
| `url` | string |  |  |  |

```sh

```
